title: Entry editor page props, contract version 1
description: The props of the panel's entry editor, Content/Editor (PRD 5.4, 11.12, 13.4), the page for a new entry of a type and the page of an entry: the address the logout posts to, the name of the type the address names, the entry the page edits or null for a new entry, the address of the type's content list, and the reads as the person: of type.describe, the type's editor descriptor the page renders its form from; of entry.get, the entry the page edits, or null for a new entry; and of node.list, the nodes a new entry's home may be, or null for the page of an entry. Each read is its result as the query's result codec wrote it at the person's classification access, or the problem details (problem.v1.json) of a rejected read, one of the two and never both. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Panel\Domain\Dto\ContentEditorPage, and the generated codec ContentEditorPageCodecV1 writes its canonical JSON: keys sorted, no whitespace.

entry.description: The id of the entry the page edits, a UUIDv7, or null for the page of a new entry.

entry_read.description: The read of entry.get, the entry the page edits; validate its result with the validator of EntryDetailV1. Null for the page of a new entry.

list.description: The address of the content list of the type, which the page leads back to and below which the page of each entry of the type is, `<list>/<entry>`.

logout.description: The address the logout posts to.

nodes_read.description: The read of node.list, the nodes the person reaches, one of which a new entry's home is; validate its result with the validator of NodeListV1. Null for the page of an entry, whose home is set.

type.description: The name of the type the address names, <owner>:<handle>, such as app:blog_post.

type_read.description: The read of type.describe, the editor descriptor of the type as the person may see it; validate its result with the validator of TypeDescriptionV1.

read.description: One read of the page: the result of its query as the result codec wrote it, or the problem details of a rejected read, one of the two and never both. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Panel\Domain\Dto\ReadAnswer.

rejection.description: The problem details of a rejected read, a document of problem.v1.json, or null for an answered read. Validate it with the validator of ProblemV1.

result.description: The result of the read's query as its result codec wrote it, or null for a rejected read.
